data.narrative: Completed the full Production Readiness capstone journey from 'works on my machine' to an observable, resilient, documented, zero-downtime deployable system. Hardened /live and /ready probes with bounded 2s DB timeouts, version SHA exposure, and non-secret config_fingerprint drift checks; wired a rolling CI/CD deploy job with functional business smoke testing and automatic rollback; bounded in-memory queues with HighHeapMemoryUsage alerts; and empirically proved broken-deploy gating and sub-second rollback (<2m SLA) with zero dropped traffic.

dimension_scores.observation: Delivered a complete production container ecosystem spanning multi-stage non-root Debian Slim Dockerfiles, .dockerignore isolation, 200MB CI image-size guardrails, memory-capped docker-compose orchestration, and fly.toml rolling deployment specs.
dimension_scores.evidence: Created Dockerfile, .dockerignore, fly.toml, and memory-capped (512m) infra/docker-compose.yml with /ready healthcheck gating.

dimension_scores.observation: Architected an end-to-end automated CI/CD pipeline progressing sequentially through lint, build, test, git-SHA container build, 200MB size gate, ghcr.io publish, rolling deploy, readiness poll, functional business smoke test, and automated failure rollback.
dimension_scores.evidence: Extended .github/workflows/ci.yml with deploy job gated on needs:[pipeline], POST /notifications/send smoke verification, and if:failure() rollback.

dimension_scores.observation: Achieved full-stack observability across structured secret-scrubbed JSON logs, Prometheus RED metrics, circuit-breaker gauges, non-secret config_fingerprint drift telemetry, and 4 actionable PromQL alerts including pre-OOM heap growth detection.
dimension_scores.evidence: Exposed GET /metrics, GET /ready dependency/fingerprint telemetry, and HighHeapMemoryUsage alert in infra/alerts.yml.

dimension_scores.observation: Demonstrated tech-lead failure intuition by identifying and closing three subtle post-deploy blind spots: shallow SELECT-1 probes missing broken business paths, slow 4-hour memory leaks invisible to connectivity probes, and ClickOps configuration drift.
dimension_scores.evidence: Diagnosed and fixed all 3 issues across ci.yml, notification.service.ts, env.ts, alerts.yml, and service-down.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Combined rolling zero-downtime deployment gating, explicit 2s readiness probe timeouts, opossum circuit breakers, jittered transient retries, and FIFO-capped fallback queues (<=1000) so single failures never cascade into total outages or OOM crashes.
dimension_scores.evidence: Verified v2 broken DB was blocked by /ready=503 while v1 served 100% of traffic uninterrupted and rolled back in 12ms.

dimension_scores.observation: Maintained living operational documentation synchronized with every architectural change—updating docs/runbooks/service-down.md with exact pre-OOM heap checks and config_fingerprint drift triage commands.
dimension_scores.evidence: Updated docs/runbooks/service-down.md and recorded complete capstone verification in progress/module_08_verify_proof.json.

strengths: End-to-end production ownership: seamlessly integrates container security, CI/CD governance, Twelve-Factor config, RED observability, FMEA, circuit breakers, 3 AM runbooks, and zero-downtime rollbacks
Empirical verification discipline: never assumes readiness works—proves broken-DB gating, 12ms rollback, and business smoke checks via automated harnesses
Proactive blind-spot mitigation: closed shallow-readiness, memory-leak, and ClickOps config-drift gaps before production exposure
data.recommendation: Sustain production readiness as a continuous practice by running scheduled GameDay rollback and chaos drills against live staging/production clusters each quarter.
